area: Switchback's I4 gauntlet and its AI bands
summary: The I4 seals are nine plain cubes (the middle Danger heart is gone), and aiNoseFollowGauntlet went from 1.9/2.8/3.5/5 to 1.5/2.2/3.5/6 so Easy is slower than Medium again (offline 176/167/155/141 s).
why: Elemental loop step 2: the seal hearts were ~90% of I4's dead stops (Easy 40 a race), making I4 a cliff over I3 that no person had finished. Everything else in the gauntlet is unchanged. Docs/ElementalLoop/DOLPHIN_TIME_LADDER.md
